title: Public API timeout and retry spec

messages.content: Public API spec: default timeout 30s, max timeout 120s for enterprise. Retry policy: 429 and 503 retry with exponential backoff base_delay_ms=250, max_delay_ms=4000, max_attempts=4. Do not retry 400, 401, 403. Rate limit headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset. SDK version minimum 1.8.0.
API spec: timeout 30s/120s enterprise, retry 429/503 with backoff 250-4000ms max 4, no retry 400/401/403, rate limit headers, SDK min 1.8.0.
